introduce: Stand in front of a wall one big step away from it. Then put your hands out straight towards the wall and lean against it. Lift your heels.\n\nSlowly bend your elbows and press your upper body towards the wall. Push back and repeat the exercise. Remember to keep your body straight.
name: WALL PUSH-UPS

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your abs.
Inhale when bending your arms, and exhale when stretching them out.
To make it harder, perform a traditional push-up on the floor.
This exercise primarily targets your chest and arms.

introduce:
Start in the regular push-up position but with your hands elevated on a chair or bench. 

Then push your body up down using your arm strength. 

Remember to keep your body straight.
name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair or bench.
Your body needs to be kept straight.
Tighten your abdominals.
You shouldn't put too much pressure on your shoulders.
Do not raise or lower your hips.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
Too easy for you? Put your feet on the bench instead of your hands.
You shouldn't feel pressure on your shoulders.
This exercise primarily works on your chest.

introduce: Start in the regular push-up position, then let your knees touch the floor and raise your feet up off the floor. \n\nNext push your body up and down.
name: KNEE PUSH-UPS

tips.text: You need to do it on a mat.
Your body should be straight.
Tighten your abdominals.
Don't rotate your shoulders towards your chest.
Don't drop or raise your head.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
To make it more difficult, perform a traditional push-up.
Your should not feel too much pressure on your shoulders.
This exercise targets all the major muscle groups of your upper body.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. \n\nBend your elbows and do a push-up. Return to the start position and repeat.
name: BOX PUSH-UPS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
This is a good exercise for your upper body.

introduce: Stand on the floor with your feet shoulder width apart. Extend your arms forward at shoulder height with your palms facing each other. \n\nExtend your arms as far out as possible, then move them back to the front. Repeat the exercise.
name: DYNAMIC CHEST

tips.text: Keep your arms straight.
Move your arms as far back as possible.
You can gradually increase the speed.
You can feel your chest and shoulders are stretching.
Inhale as you extend your arms out as far as possible, and exhale as you bring your arms back together in the front.
This exercise can stretch your chest and shoulders.

introduce:
Find a doorway, take a lunge position in the doorway with your arms on the doorframe and your elbows a little lower than your shoulders, then slowly bring your chest forward. 

Hold this position for 30-40 seconds. Then slowly come out of it, bring your arms down and do a couple of shoulder rolls.

Don’t pull your head forward, and keep your neck relaxed.
name: CHEST STRETCH

tips.text: Please stand in front of a doorway.
Please keep you neck relaxed.
Please don’t pull your lower back or head forward.
You should feel stretch in your chest and shoulders.
You shouldn\'t feel any pain.
Inhale deeply and slowly, feeling your chest expand.
Exhale slowly, feeling your chest contract.
This exercise stretches your chest and shoulders.

introduce: Place one arm across your body, parallel to the ground, then use the other arm to pull the parallel arm toward your chest. \n\nHold for a while, switch arms and repeat the exercise. Keep the inside arm straight during the exercise.
name: SHOULDER STRETCH

tips.text: Please keep your stretched arm straight.
You should feel a little tension in your shoulder.
This exercise stretches your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Put your left hand on your back, use your right hand to grab your left elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: TRICEPS STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your left shoulder down when pulling your left elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Put your right hand on your back, use your left hand to grab your right elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: TRICEPS STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your right shoulder down when pulling your right elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.
